usage: Use 假 to mean something that is not real, not genuine, or imitation goods.
Very common in shopping contexts, especially for jewellery, watches, handbags, and luxury-brand items.
As an adjective, it often comes before a noun; in speech, people also say it by itself to judge an item as fake.
In everyday Cantonese, 假 can sound blunt, so sellers may prefer softer wording like 價錢平啲嘅貨 or 仿製品.
